defects.name: Misleading Last Renewal meaning
defects.v1_disposition: Expose only the source-reported field under an explicitly source-reported, semantically unresolved name; never model or document it as an accepted-submission date.
defects.note: Renamed to source_reported_last_renewal_date with an explicit semantic-uncertainty description; assert_staging_semantics.sql proves the required name exists and that no accepted-submission-shaped alias is ever present.

downstream_obligations.requirement: Compute the three locked Last Renewal transition-diagnostic measures against observed exits, and prove that clearing this field is never treated as the event definition.

defects.name: Private-foundation undercount
defects.v1_disposition: Out of v1. No IRS or private-foundation segmentation source, model, or derived flag is introduced anywhere in the dbt project or product analytical code.
defects.note: The excluded federal identifier column is retained in staging only for internal row-level reconciliation and is never used, exposed, or joined as identity; no IRS/private-foundation model or field exists.

defects.name: Direction-dependent Date Status Set
defects.v1_disposition: Expose only the source-reported current-status date under an explicit source-reported name; prohibit exact-onset naming or use anywhere in Phase 3.
defects.note: Renamed to source_reported_current_status_date; assert_staging_semantics.sql proves the required name exists and that no exact-onset-shaped alias is ever present.

downstream_obligations.requirement: Derive transition onset and exit only as release-interval bounds, and never substitute the source-reported current-status date as an exact transition onset.

defects.name: Substring web lookup
defects.v1_disposition: Longitudinal identity is the exact trimmed full nonblank State Charity registration number; no fuzzy or substring official-web join is ingested or used.
defects.note: assert_exact_registration_identity.sql proves exact retention with no FEIN fallback and no FEIN aliasing; no fuzzy-web join field or model exists anywhere in Phase 3.

downstream_obligations.requirement: Require name narrowing followed by explicit selection of a displayed exact organization/full-registration-number candidate, including duplicate-name disambiguation, before any history is shown; never a fuzzy substring web join.

defects.name: IRS revocation event log
defects.v1_disposition: Out of v1. No IRS revocation source, model, or event relation is introduced anywhere in the dbt project or product analytical code.
defects.note: No IRS revocation source, model, or event relation exists; the defect note is retained here for any future extension decision.

defects.name: Incomplete identifier catalog
defects.v1_disposition: Keep Phase 2 admission as the sole owner of identifier-family classification; Phase 3 consumes only admitted Parquet and adds no raw identifier-family parser.
defects.note: Identifier-family classification remains owned and tested by Phase 2 admission; Phase 3 adds only the Parquet-only boundary proof that dbt never reopens raw CSV identifier parsing.

defects.name: Inconsistent encoding
defects.v1_disposition: Keep Phase 2's strict CP1252 decode with no replacement-character path as the sole owner; Phase 3 reads only admitted Parquet.
defects.note: CP1252 strict-decode/no-U+FFFD admission remains owned and tested by Phase 2; Phase 3 adds no replacement-character path and never reopens raw CSV.

defects.name: Claimed embedded newlines
defects.v1_disposition: Keep Phase 2's corrected diagnosis (unmatched quote plus default-parser fusion, not embedded newlines) as the sole owner; physical-line/record reconciliation stays in Phase 2.
defects.note: Unmatched-quote/physical-line reconciliation remains owned and tested by Phase 2; the embedded-newline diagnosis stays explicitly rejected and no newline-aware or raw-CSV code exists in Phase 3.
